blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 Cabinet Extends PM-KISAN Scheme for 5 Years (FY27 to FY31) with ₹3,15,614 Crore Outlay. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Reaffirms DBT income support of ₹6,000 annually to eligible landholding farmer families.
5-Year Extension: Total financial outlay of ₹3,15,614 crore (over ₹3.15 lakh crore) through FY31.
Disbursement Track Record: Over ₹4.5 lakh crore disbursed since Feb 2019 inception; 1 out of 4 beneficiaries is a woman farmer.
PM-KISAN 5-year extension outlay (₹3.15 lakh crore) vs total disbursed since inception (₹4.5 lakh crore).
